advancements.story.cutie_mark.title: Mah Cutie Mark!
creator.unicorn.desc:
Unicorn

Equipped with a magical horn, you can cast spells and craft your own, but you deal 25% less damage, and have 2 less hearts.
creator.pegasus.desc:
Pegasus

With a light frame and wings, you can glide (Racial Primary to gain height) and walk 25% faster, but you have 9 hearts instead of 10.
creator.earth.desc:
Earth Pony

Built sturdy and close to nature, you have natural 5 points of armor, 5 extra hearts, and plants less than 120 blocks away grow faster.

skill.mlpfrien.root_cm.description: You finally found your Cutie Mark, and many abilities come from your talent
skill.mlpfrien.high_range.description: You can place and break 3 blocks further than usual
skill.mlpfrien.fall_resist.description: You need to fall from 10 blocks higher to start taking fall damage
skill.mlpfrien.replacing.description: You can toggle replacing blocks instead of placing with the Primary Ability key
skill.mlpfrien.extra_breaking.descriptio: You can break any block that requires a stone tool or less with your hands or any block
skill.mlpfrien.extra_fortune.description: You get extra drops from blocks, stacks with enchantments
skill.mlpfrien.high_vision.description: You can see in the dark, toggleable with the Primary Ability key
